Wins are collected in the note 'Instant Payouts: wins record' (40 merchants live, 99.7% success, 18 min median; PAY-1199 stale bank destination bug fixed within 24 h; Northbay Coffee retained), for her next review.
Northline Renovations progress draw #3 of $7,200 is due Wed 3 Jun 2026 from the joint account.

Hannah is a neighbour/friend on Logan whose kids include Ellie; Hannah offered to help look after Biscuit (Riya's dog). Biscuit howls at sirens (fire trucks); kid-friendly explanation: he thinks a far-away dog is calling and sings back to say 'I'm here'.

Riya wants Hannah to feed and walk Biscuit while the family is away in July 2026 (Vancouver trip Thu 9 Jul to Mon 13 Jul), and they will pay her. The text has not been sent: the assistant needs the dates first.

Biscuit (Riya's dog) is moving to Riverside Veterinary Clinic; the old clinic is Leslieville Animal Hospital (full chart not yet transferred). His birth date is not on file. Vaccines: Rabies and DHPP 2025-03-14 (next due 2028-03), Bordetella 2026-03-02 (next due 2027-03); PDF in notes as 'Biscuit: vaccinations'. The Riverside intake form link expires Fri 5 Jun 2026.
Leo attends Morse Street Public School (Grade 2); school updates go through Edsby and School Cash Online. Principal is Ms. D. Fraser.
Leo's Grade 2 Toronto Zoo trip is Thu 11 Jun 2026; the permission form and $18 fee are due Thu 4 Jun (Fri 5 Jun is a PA day) via School Cash Online. Volunteers are needed, 2 per class.
Leo's school library books are due back to Morse Street PS by Fri 12 Jun 2026 (a notice goes out for missing books). Lost and found items are donated Mon 22 Jun, so label clothing and water bottles.

Morse Street PS end of year 2026: Track and Field Day Wed 17 Jun (rain date Thu 18 Jun; volunteers needed), report cards via Edsby Tue 23 Jun, primary class picnic Thu 25 Jun 17:30, last day Fri 26 Jun with 12:00 early dismissal, TPL Summer Reading Club starts Sat 27 Jun.
Conflict: Fri 26 Jun 2026 Leo's school dismisses early at 12:00, overlapping Riya's work-calendar block 'Payouts GA go/no-go prep' 11:30-12:00. Pickup needs planning.

Riya is arranging a team lunch for 8 people near the Lumen Pay office (King St W) next Thursday (11 Jun 2026) to celebrate the beta wrapping up. Top candidate Saffron Lane (South Indian, 4.6, groups up to 12, private corner table); alternatives Planta Queen (set menu for 8+) and Pai (walk-in only). Time not yet chosen, availability not yet checked.

Basement dehumidifier (Frigidaire 50-pint FFAP5033W1) stopped collecting water (fan runs). Bought 6 Jul 2025 at Canadian Tire Leaside, order #CT-5523-118, $319.21, no protection plan. 1-year parts and labour warranty until about 6 Jul 2026 (sealed system 5 years). Online claim form drafted but not submitted. Call reminder Mon 8 Jun 12:15. Basement humidity was 61%; Hannah Cho has a spare 30-pint to borrow.
Riya posts a weekly payouts status update in #payouts-launch every Friday by 16:00 (workstreams colour-coded; GA docs was amber on 29 May).

Sprint planning is on 15 Jun 2026. Riya must cut two items from Onboarding v2.1 scope: draft is 44 pts versus 30 pts capacity (over by 14). Candidates: bulk CSV import (13, not started), partner referral codes (5), business-verification retry (8), progress-saving (8); keep accessibility fixes (in progress) and French onboarding emails. Biscuit's lunchtime walks: Jess M. from Rover walks him Tuesdays and Thursdays at 12:00 (30 min, $27 per walk, from Tue 9 Jun 2026, about $54/week). On Riya's work-from-home days (Mon, Wed, Fri) she walks Biscuit herself at 12:00 around Greenwood Park.

Riya's weekly runs with Marcus are Wednesdays 06:15-07:15 and Saturdays 07:30-08:45 at Ashbridges Bay (changed in June 2026 when Marcus started a new job). The old Sunday 07:30 Leslie St series was ended.

Riya prefers a single recommendation rather than three options; give one pick with at most a single fallback only if it really matters.
Riya's household: partner Sam Okafor (a teacher), son Leo, and Biscuit, their beagle. They live in Leslieville, Toronto.

Notes in 'Dec 2026 holiday - options' (n-3982).

Not yet held.

The family will be in Lisbon on Christmas Eve (24 Dec, consoada); most Lisbon restaurants close early or have set menus then, and booking opens in October. Options: Taberna da Rua das Flores (Chiado, EUR 45 menu), Time Out Market (until 18:00), Baixa hotel restaurants; Cervejaria Ramiro is closed Dec 24-25. Not booked yet.
